user.title: Set up Overcast
user.description: Overcast adds a notify entity for each Fire TV running the Overcast app. After setup, create a long-lived access token (ideally for a dedicated non-admin user) and enter it with your Home Assistant URL in the app on each TV. TVs appear here automatically when they connect.

not_connected.message: {name} is not connected, and the notification has a ttl of 0, so it was not queued.

no_https_url.message: Camera and image snapshots need an https URL for Home Assistant (for example Home Assistant Cloud or an external URL with TLS). Set one under Settings > System > Network, or use image_url instead.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Shows a toast on one or more Overcast TVs, with optional image, duration and an action that opens an app.

title.name: Title
title.description: First line of the toast. Defaults to "Home Assistant".

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the toast stays on screen.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: https URL of an image to show as the toast icon. It must be reachable from the TV without authentication.

image_entity.name: Image entity
image_entity.description: Camera or image entity to show as the toast icon. Sent as a short-lived signed URL, which needs an https URL for Home Assistant.

launch_uri.name: Launch URI
launch_uri.description: App to open from the toast's action, for example pkg://com.example.app.main.

ttl.name: Time to live
ttl.description: If the TV is not connected, how long to keep the notification for it. 0 fails the action instead.
